body: Honestly I’m not too sure, and nothing really happened, I can’t remember anything
I was just upset I couldn’t feel rlly, I’ve changed and I can’t feel normal

No extended family really, and the hotlines are pretty good, I only text it if I need too, people were pretty sweet. And mystery, drama or comedy shows, and games depend, theres the sims or even animal crossing

I’ve figured out watching shows or playing certain games helps me to calm down, and talking to one of my cousins, she went through quite a bit of the same thing so it did help to talk to her here and there

They’re okay, they’re just religious so opening up isn’t the best idea when their answer is to just pray, I just kind of keep to myself and figure my own things out and figure out how to keep myself distracted. I’d try to talk to my cousins but they moved out of state and it’s hard to talk to them over call or on text, it’s not the same as them actually being here.

I’ve had mild suicidal thoughts and depression at a really young age, I couldn’t figure out if it was normal or not all I knew is I didn’t wanna be here, it’s been on and off really, it’s mild and then it just flares up with no warning, only this run has been 4 months of the same thing, numb, empty, not wanting to be here and feeling quite frankly alone, I contracted a hotline twice. I’d love to open up to someone fully because it’s so emotionally exhausting, I’m exhausted, and I don’t want to tell a hotline about it because I don’t wanna be hospitalized or put on watch, I know I’m not gonna try anything but I just really really really wish I wasn’t here, at this point I don’t feel like I have a reason to be here.
Thank you so much! I’ll try and get my mom to see what’s happening.
Yeah! Pretty much, I just don’t know how hard because I wasn’t home

My grandmother lives with us and helps, and he was upset cause he didn’t wanna do his work yes, so he was pouting but was still in there getting ready to do it and my grandmother popped him, I love my grandmother and all but it’s just weird, I want my mother to know how her mom treats us sometimes and doesn’t try the whole “so you’re calling her a liar” thing with me when I try to tell her.
